comparison.objective: Complete a Latin-square layout so each row and column contains one of each colour and length; candidate performs insert-tang removal.
comparison.physical_skill: Combinatorial sorting and placement do not test hammer manipulation, coaxial insertion, force regulation, fracture, or debris recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Title requires row/column uniqueness for both colour and length; candidate requires four physical fractures, four recovered tangs, and no damage.
comparison.reason: The record provides no body, numeric tolerances, partial-credit rules, or stability criteria, but the stated layout objective is clearly unrelated to the candidate's tested physical mechanism.
